title: DebateConfig + DebateResult — typed engine models (Epic 6, orchestration sub-PRD §2)
prompt:
Define DebateConfig (rounds, max_words, models, timeout, retries) and DebateResult (transcript, tool_calls, nudges, closing_discussion, verdict, token/cost totals). See docs/prds/debate-orchestration.md.

Follow repo standards: TDD (write the failing test first, then code); max 150 lines per code file (split, don't compress); ruff = 0 violations + mypy clean; no hard-coded values (read from config); every external API call goes through the API gatekeeper (Epic 13); log via the LOG package; keep coverage >= 85%. Read docs/PRD.md and the relevant docs/prds/*.md before starting.
note: FIRST task of Epic 6 (the orchestration engine): the TYPED MODELS ONLY — no debate loop (that is 6.2+). NEW engine subpackage packages/core/src/agent_debate/core/engine/ with two code files (each <=150 code lines, split not compressed): engine/models.py = DebateConfig (the input contract) and engine/result.py = DebateResult output plus DebateMessage / ToolCallRecord / CostTotals; engine/__init__.py re-exports the five public names. CONFIG-DRIVEN: DebateConfig.from_settings(settings) lifts rounds/max_words/turn_timeout_s/max_retries/debater_model/controller_model and the resolved per-side pro_model/con_model straight from Settings (which reads the PRD §7 table / env) — NO hard-coded defaults in the engine; the model only VALIDATES bounds (rounds/max_words/turn_timeout_s > 0 via Field(gt=0); max_retries >= 0 via Field(ge=0)). DebateResult REUSES the existing skills models NudgeMessage / Verdict / DebateSide rather than re-modelling them; verdict is Optional (a result can be built before judgement). CostTotals.from_messages aggregates input/output/total tokens + cost_usd + latency_ms across turns (mirrors GatekeeperStatus.from_services). DebateMessage exposes word_count as a Pydantic computed_field, so that model uses extra='ignore' (not forbid) to let the JSON dump round-trip cleanly; DebateConfig/DebateResult/CostTotals/ToolCallRecord are frozen+extra='forbid' as appropriate and all round-trip via model_dump_json/model_validate_json. RE-EXPORT (split, not compress): the hub core/__init__.py already sat at the 150-code-line cap, so the engine re-export group was factored into a new _engine_public.py shim (explicit imports + an explicit, mypy-checked __all__ of 5 names) mirroring the existing _agents_public.py precedent; the hub pulls it in via `from ._engine_public import *` AND splices the shim's __all__ with `*_engine_public.__all__` (no new literal __all__ entries) so the hub stays under 150 code lines while ruff F822/mypy still see the names. API gatekeeper (Epic 13): N/A — pure typed Pydantic models, no network/LLM call. LOG package: N/A — these are data models the engine loop (6.2+) will populate and log. TDD red-first: wrote packages/core/tests/test_debate_models.py (14 tests, exactly 150 code lines) and watched it fail (ImportError: cannot import name 'CostTotals') before implementing. Tests assert from_settings is config-driven (changing a setting changes the config), per-side PRO/CON model fallback, bounds validation (rejects rounds<=0 etc.), CostTotals aggregation, computed word_count, full DebateResult composition (transcript/tool_calls/nudges/closing_discussion/verdict/totals reusing NudgeMessage+Verdict), optional verdict, and JSON round-trip for both config and result. Gates green locally: uv sync clean; ruff check = All checks passed; ruff format --check clean (122 files); mypy = no issues in 122 source files; pytest --cov = 481 passed, total coverage 100% (>=85); check_line_limit pass (no file over 150 code lines, incl. the re-spliced hub __init__); secret_scan pass. See PR CI for the authoritative result.
